generate_nsys_profile_shell_script: generate a shell script that runs Nsight Systems profiling on a Habitat-lab DDPPO PointNav training job
generate_slurm_profile_scripts: generate slurm submission and task shell scripts for distributed profiling across multiple nodes
configure_step_range_capture: configure Nsight Systems to capture a specific range of training steps using NVTX markers
configure_time_range_capture: configure Nsight Systems to capture profiling data over a fixed delay and duration in seconds
export_sqlite_profile: export the Nsight Systems profile as a SQLite database for use with compare_profiles.py
